messages:
emma_prod: Quick sync on the Usage & Billing landing mocks I dropped: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/usage-billing-v5 — main decision: unified org header vs project-first dashboard. Want opinions before design review.

liam_design: I tried a 'project-first' default for teams that operate per-project, but the hierarchy felt noisy for org admins. New idea: adaptive landing — show org summary for accounts with >1 owner, otherwise show project grid.

sam_sre: adaptive makes sense but adds client-side logic. For metrics queries, we prefer server-side determinism. Could the backend return a recommended default scope with user metadata?

nora_fin: from billing perspective, org-first is the canonical source: invoices, payment method, billing contacts are org-scoped. If product shows project-first by default it might confuse which entity is billed.

liam_design: noted. What if we surface a persistent scope toggle (Org / Project) in the top-left, defaulted by backend recommendation? Toggle state could be part of the URL so it’s shareable.

emma_prod: I like the shareable URL idea. Also want to reduce cognitive load: the top header should contain total month-to-date spend + a status pill (over/under budget). Projects should be quick cards with 3 metrics: Est charges, tokens, top model.

hannah_a11y: a11y points: 1) scope toggle must be a real <button> with aria-pressed, not a faux link. 2) color for the status pill needs >=4.5:1 contrast against bg for text. 3) all charts must have data tables accessible to screen readers and keyboard focusable legends.

liam_design: will switch scope toggle to a semantic button and add aria-pressed. Also updating pill colors. For project cards: compact variant shows sparkline + tiny badge for invoice link. Expanded card shows ledger preview. Thoughts on showing token breakup inline vs accordion?

sam_sre: show summary inline, and lazy-load the detailed token route list in an accordion. Important: the expand action should not trigger full re-compute on the billing service; return cached summary and page route list via a paged API.

emma_prod: good. Also product request: include a small 'why this changed' toast when switching scope for users — short copy like "You're now viewing Project-level charges. Invoices remain at org level."

nora_fin: yes please. Also enforce role-based access: only billing admins can download invoices. In project view, the 'Download' CTA should direct to org invoice if the user lacks billing role.

hannah_a11y: tiny keyboard nit: the project card preview should be dismissible with Esc and trap focus when expanded. Add a visible close button with an aria-label.

liam_design: updated mock: cards have a keyboard affordance, aria-expanded toggles, and a close icon. I've added the toast copy. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/usage-billing-v5?node-id=88%3A10

emma_prod: Implementation notes for eng: 1) scope toggle state in URL. 2) server returns recommended default_scope in /me. 3) token detail endpoints paginated. Sam, can you confirm API readiness?

sam_sre: API ready for recommended_scope and paginated token endpoints. Will add a feature flag for adaptive landing so we can roll out gradually.

emma_prod: timeline: design final by Friday, dev spike next week, a11y check on first build. Owner assignments: Liam (design), Sam (API/flag), Nora (billing copy), Hannah (a11y sign-off).

deploy-bot: Heads up: design-review slot confirmed Friday 15:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent. :white_check_mark:

liam_design: one last UX question — should the org header include a tiny inline breakdown of discounts & credits? customers asked for it in support.

emma_prod: yes but keep it collapsed by default ("Credits applied: $X" with link to expand) — avoid clutter.

hannah_a11y: ensure the collapse control is keyboard reachable and labeled like "Show credits details".

nora_fin: copy suggestion: replace 'Est charges' with 'Estimated charges (pre-tax)'. Better for legal clarity.

liam_design: updated copy accordingly.

emma_prod: thanks everyone. I'll consolidate the action items in the PR and tag people. If no blockers, we'll lock the mocks after Friday's review.

sam_sre: quick ask : can we avoid client rendering of large sparklines for orgs with >1000 projects? fallback to aggregated sparkline server-side.

liam_design: added note to spec.

emma_prod: OK closing thread. Ping if anything else comes up.
